brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a game that let's you prove there was only one shooter in the jfk incident in Dallas by realistically simulating in first person how it could have been perpetrated by a lone gunman
note: built singlebullet.bisks.net — skipped the shooter, built the trig: schedule 3 shots against the rifle's real bolt-cycle time, then test if one line explains both men's wounds. sliders, not a scope.
